title: method-cards
description: The method-selection catalogue: one card per method family, carrying the guidance a user needs to choose between them. The SHA-256 sidecar beside this artifact proves it is the file that was sealed; this schema proves it is the right SHAPE, which a fresh digest over a wrong file does not. Every field below was read off the artifact on disk, not recalled: `additionalProperties: false` on a card is therefore load-bearing, because it is what catches a field being reintroduced, renamed or invented.

node_specs_sha256.description: Pins this catalogue to one exact node-specs.json. The two artifacts are a matched pair and a card that describes nodes which no longer exist is worse than no card at all.

wrapper_file.description: The module that implements this card's methods. naming.py and the gateway join on this value, so a card pointing at a module that does not exist breaks routing rather than merely misinforming a reader.

tool_fns.description: The wire function names this card covers. Never empty: a card that routes to nothing cannot be recommended.

alternatives.description: Where to go instead, and the criterion that sends you there. A bare list of method names would be useless guidance, so each entry carries both halves and both are required.

sources.description: Academic citations. Null is permitted and is measured: exactly one card carries no source today. It is not the same as an empty list, which would assert that the question was asked and answered with nothing.

precondition_tools.description: Diagnostics to run before trusting this method. Null where the question does not arise; a list where it does.

embed_text.description: The retrieval text, rebuilt from the fields above rather than hand-written, so it cannot drift away from the card it describes.
